name: How do I choose the right flooring when flipping versus renting a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right flooring when flipping versus renting a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should select flooring that aligns with your timeline, budget, and target audience. For a fix-and-flip, standardizing on a neutral, modern luxury vinyl plank across the main levels paired with tile in the bathrooms creates broad buyer appeal without excessive expenditure. For rental properties, heavy-duty waterproof vinyl plank stands up well to tenant wear and tear. If you are rehabbing the home as a personal residence, higher-end finishes like natural stone, marble, or engineered hardwood may be worth the extra investment. We help owners balance durable materials against the home's expected market value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose neutral, waterproof luxury vinyl plank and tile for rentals and flips to manage costs and maximize durability, reserving premium tile or hardwood for personal residences.
